findings:
Technique:
Whole body images were acquired after intra-venous injection of standard dose of 99m Tc-MDP at 3 hrs.
Findings:
There is evidence of increased tracer uptake in the region of:
Multiple costo-transverse junctions bilaterally
Bilateral sternoclavicular junctions
Bilateral SI joints.
Corresponding SPECT-CT images demonstrate:
Early ankylosis of multiple costo-transverse junctions bilaterally.
Bilateral iliac sclerosis at the SI joint. 
Multiple small erosions with sclerosis of the anterior end of dorso-lumbar vertebrae (shiny corner sign)
impression:
SCAN FEATURES SUGGEST MULTIPLE BILATERAL COSTO-TRANSVERSE JOINT, STERNOCLAVICULAR, BILATERAL SI JOINTS, INVOLVEMENT; CONSISTENT WITH SERO NEGATIVE SPONDYLO ARTHROPATHY? EARLY ANKYLOSING SPONDYLITIS.

NO DEFINITE EVIDENCE OF INFECTION / TB.


Dr Ajit S Shinto                          Dr K K Kamaleshwaran
Chief Consultant,NM                      Consultant,NM

Technique: 
whole body images were acquired after intra-venous injection of standard dose of 99m Tc-MDP at 3 hrs.
Findings:
Foci of abnormal increased tracer uptake noted in the region of:
Bilateral SI joints (Right>Left)
Multiple dorso-lumbar vertebrae
Abnormal tracer uptake also noted in:
Bilateral shoulders
Bilateral knees and ankles
impression:
SCAN FEATURES CONSISTENT WITH BILATERAL SACROILITIS. RIGHT IS MUCH MORE THAN ACTIVE THAN LEFT.
SCAN FEATURES ALSO CONSISTENT WITH ANKYLOSING SPONDYLITIS.
